source: Written for VPM to stylis 4.4.0's API, element tree and output. stylis's tests are retained in scripts/stylis-conformance/upstream; the prefix rules follow stylis's (src/Prefixer.js), keyed by property name.
changes: Vendor prefixes are chosen by property name, not by a hash of the name's length and first four characters, which gave more than 50 unprefixed properties invented declarations (-webkit-box-flex-wrap, -ms-grid-gap, scroll-snap-padding-top, -ms-grid-row-span:-97...). backdrop-filter keeps its -webkit- form.
IE grid spans pair start and end lines of the same axis and are written for that axis.
mask-composite converts every layer's keyword for -webkit-mask-composite, including subtract.
A declaration's property ends at its first colon.
A comment at the end of the input keeps its text.
namespace gives the same result on every engine (stylis's case-label assignment scopes a:not(...) as a.scope:not.scope(...) on JavaScriptCore).
Each compile() and tokenize() call has its own cursor.
ES module sources only (no UMD or minified bundle) and bundled declarations.

verification.upstreamTestAdaptations: Ten prefix() calls pass a length other than the property name's and one assertion depends on that; see the fixture README.
verification.differential: Element trees and stringify, prefixer, rulesheet and namespace output identical to stylis 4.4.0 with the changes above applied, over 12 stylesheets and 20,000 generated inputs.
